items.title: NYSOFA expands partnership with Intuition Robotics to bring ElliQ to more seniors
items.summary: With the expansion, NYSOFA and Intuition Robotics established a new three-year, $2.1 million agreement to keep rolling out ElliQ.The post NYSOFA expands partnership with Intuition Robotics to bring ElliQ to more seniors appeared first on The Robot Report.
